The '''Waima language ''' (sometimes known as '''Roro''', though this is strictly the name of one dialect of Waima) is a [[Nuclear West Central Papuan Tip languages|Nuclear West Central Papuan Tip language]] of the [[Oceanic languages|Oceanic group]] of [[Malayo-Polynesian languages]], spoken in [[Papua New Guinea]] by 15,000 people. The three dialects, Waima, Roro, and Paitana, are very close.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ethnologue.com/language/rro|title = Waima}}</ref>
